title: Rigidity of Einstein Manifolds under Two Eigenvalue Conditions on the Curvature Operator of the Second Kind
summary: We prove a rigidity theorem for closed Einstein manifolds of dimension $n\ge6$ under two lower bounds on the curvature operator of the second kind. More precisely, for $L_1, L_2\ge0$ and some real number $α>1$ in a suitable range, we consider \[ λ_1\ge-L_1\barλ, \qquad \frac1α\sum_{j=1}^αλ_j \ge-L_2\barλ. \] Here $λ_1\le\cdots\leλ_N$ are the eigenvalues of the curvature operator of the second kind $\mathring R$, $N=(n-1)(n+2)/2$, and $\barλ=N^{-1}\sum_{j=1}^Nλ_j$.
